verdict.rationale: Portkey's AI gateway provides a single unified API/base URL and one API key to access 250+/1600+ models across providers (OpenAI, AWS, Azure, Vertex, on-prem) with consistent request/response handling, fallbacks, and virtual keys abstracting credentials. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond vendor docs, and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s) to verify API consistency claims.
